verdict.rationale: SigNoz's source is public on GitHub and described as free and open-source (signoz-gh-1, signoz-probe-2), so the core of the story is met. A community report notes the repo's 'ee/' directory is under a separate license, which makes the product open-core rather than fully open, and the evidence never names the license. Missing for 10: the specific open license is not identified, the ee/ directory is not under the open license, and there is no first-party licensing documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
